CustomField.description: Skill versioning: when the current Version_Number__c took effect. Set only by ChatbotInstructionTrigger, together with the number. Unlike Last Modified Date it does not move on re-ordering, description, Usage, Active or position edits. Records that existed before versioning shipped carry their Last Modified Date at that time (CFO Bot labels it "on record since").
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically: when the current version took effect.
CustomField.label: Version Date
